mode: NLI supervised training plus typed-workflow replay; new domains evaluated; not proven arbitrary-task generality

corpus_manifest.input: premise as state; hypothesis in instructions; relation and guarantee criteria
corpus_manifest.selection: hash-based, grouped by normalized premise; evaluation sampled by pair ID before scoring
corpus_manifest.licenses: MultiNLI source licenses retained; typed-decisions Apache-2.0; converter MIT

manifest.selection: mean NLI/typed validation NLL; no test selection
manifest.objective: CE + .1 Brier + .1 score RPS; equal decision weights; typed replay
